observedTests.name: Installed encrypted UI
observedTests.observed: Real WebCrypto, exact record hashes, Python parity, read-only comparison, accessibility, lock/reopen and unauthenticated refusal passed; zero outside requests and normal exit 0.

observedTests.name: Old-to-new vault
observedTests.observed: An immutable 0.3.0 compatibility binary created and edited a synthetic encrypted vault. Installed 0.3.1 used the same login and phrase and retained its exact edited record hash.

observedTests.name: Source and packages
observedTests.observed: Exact-main CI and processed three-language CodeQL passed. All three real native builds and final draft verification passed; all six independent asset downloads matched provider SHA-256.

observedTests.name: Installation and icons
observedTests.observed: A fresh per-version Windows folder and individual Desktop/Start-menu targets were verified. Normal accounts and Docker were unchanged; default-profile shortcut activation remains separately untested.

visualReview.scope: Every final page content individually viewed; only exact identical pixels carry prior inspection. Screenshots are actual installed synthetic workflows.
